mechanism: Modafinil induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially reducing clobazam and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam concentrations, while clobazam may induce modafinil metabolism.
action: Monitor seizure control and modafinil efficacy closely; consider clobazam dose adjustment or alternative modafinil if breakthrough seizures or reduced wakefulness occur.
